phases.name: plan
phases.description: T4 resident live: emit the implementation plan marker before the gated build

phases.name: build
phases.description: T4 resident live: gated build whose test command fails attempt 1 and passes attempt 2 (state-file counter under the leg's TMPDIR), so DF1.3 authorizes retry attempt 2 and the post_gate_failure solicitation point is reached with real gate evidence
testCommand: f="$TMPDIR/qds-t4-resident-count"; n=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); n=$((n+1)); printf '%s' "$n" > "$f"; echo "t4 test attempt $n"; test "$n" -ge 2
